scope: Fine management attribution of the actual public Fresh K16 loop; diagnostic only
profiler: xctrace Time Profiler CPU sampling, attach after actual init marker +500ms; 2s recording; no concurrent build or benchmark
stopping: Exactly two blocks if profiler works; process/identity/correctness failure stops and is retained. Unavailable profiler is recorded and triggers a targeted diagnostic fallback, never a qualification claim.
attribution: Filter actual write loop by stack and thread. Main thread running CPU samples only for CPU shares; separate background. Exclusive group each sample once; inclusive caller context separate. Retain unsymbolicated samples and report coverage.
limits: CPU sampling is not wall or lock-wait timing, no formal confidence pass or substitution into the frozen 40-pair estimator. Counts or samples alone do not prove causal removable work.
